_comment: Maps OpenAI POST /v1/images/generations onto a CONSTRAINED server-side workflow template (specs/14_IMAGE_GENERATION.md, specs/02_PROTOCOL_AND_API.md). Standard OpenAI clients use only the top-level bindings; InferWeave-specific fields ride in the optional `inferweave` request object or documented headers so stock SDKs never break. Public clients never submit workflow graphs; only the named template and these bound inputs are accepted.

inferweave_extensions._comment: Supplied via the `inferweave` request object or X-InferWeave-* headers.
